shots.card:
RECOVERED FROM THE BUILDING
TAPE 1 OF 1

shots.note: inside the car: the doors open on fog and a street that goes nowhere
out to the payphone; the follower is far off in the fog
the laundromat: slow push to the one on the bench, under the notice
down the aisle to the stage; the lens stands in the way
the ward: weave the drawn curtains, glance into bay 2, turn to bay 3
the stairwell, black except three flashes; the landing door on the left
the chapel from the back: the one in the pew is facing the camera
along the mirrors: your reflection, and the one a step behind it
the Records: tilt down to the log and the ringing phone
game capture: it's behind you in the car; the burst comes off; nothing under it
